lines.text: Use this job aid to key a supplier invoice that did not arrive through the invoice inbox.
You need the Payables Clerk role.
Have the supplier invoice PDF ready to attach.
Go to Payables > Invoices > Create Invoice.
Enter the supplier name, supplier site and invoice number exactly as printed on the invoice.
Enter the invoice date, invoice amount and payment terms.
For a PO invoice, enter the purchase order number in the Identifying PO field.
Attach the invoice PDF and select Validate.
Select Save and Close. The invoice enters the approval workflow.
Duplicate invoice numbers for the same supplier are blocked at validation.
Invoices dated more than 90 days in the past need AP Operations Supervisor review.

articles.title: Match an invoice to a purchase order

lines.text: Use this job aid to match a supplier invoice to purchase order lines and receipts.
Open the invoice from Payables > Invoices > Manage Invoices.
Select Match and choose the purchase order lines to match.
Confirm the match level. Goods lines use three-way match against the receipt.
Review the quantity and price variances shown on the match page.
Select Apply, then select Validate.
Price variance tolerance is 5% or $250.00, whichever is lower.
Lines without a receipt place the invoice on an RCV hold.

articles.title: Release an invoice from a matching hold

lines.text: Use this job aid to clear a matching hold so an invoice can be paid.
Go to Payables > Invoices > Holds Workbench.
Filter by hold code, for example QTY, PRC or RCV.
Open the invoice and review the hold reason.
Resolve the cause first: post the receipt, correct the PO price or update the invoice quantity.
Select Validate. The hold releases automatically when the cause is resolved.
Only the AP Operations Supervisor can manually release a PRC hold.
Holds older than 30 days appear on the weekly hold aging report.
Use this job aid to void a supplier payment that was issued in error.
Go to Payables > Payments > Manage Payments.
Search for the payment by payment number and open it.
Select Void and enter the void date and the void reason.
Choose the invoice action Unapply so the invoices reopen for payment.
Select Submit. Voids of payments over $50,000.00 require AP Operations Supervisor approval.
You cannot void a payment that has already cleared the bank. Raise a refund request instead.
Use this job aid to change the bank account a supplier is paid to.
You need the Supplier Bank Maintainer role.
Every bank change requires a callback to the supplier.
Go to Payables > Suppliers > Manage Suppliers and open the supplier.
On the Payments tab, select the remit-to site and choose Add Bank Account.
Call the supplier at the phone number already on file, not the number on the change request, and record the callback date.
Enter the new bank details and attach the signed change request form.
Select Submit. The change routes to a second Supplier Bank Maintainer for approval.
New bank details stay on a BNK hold for 3 business days after approval.
Never accept a bank change by email alone.

Confirm the cost center on each distribution line.
Select Actions > Initiate Approval.
The invoice routes to the cost center manager first.
Non-PO invoices over $5,000.00 also require a second approver from Finance.

Open the approval notification from your worklist.
Review the invoice image, the amount and the cost center.
Select Approve, Reject or Request Information.
Add a comment when you reject or request information.
Non-PO invoices over $10,000.00 also require a second approver from Finance.

lines.text: Use this job aid to record a supplier credit memo and apply it to an open invoice.
Go to Payables > Invoices > Create Invoice and set the invoice type to Credit Memo.
Enter the credit amount as a negative number.
Enter the original invoice in the Related Invoice field.
Select Validate, then Save and Close.
Credit memos over $10,000.00 need AP Operations Supervisor review.

lines.text: Use this job aid to reconcile a supplier statement against open invoices and payments.
Go to Payables > Suppliers > Supplier Balances and open the supplier.
Compare the supplier statement to the open invoices and payments listed.
For each missing invoice, request a copy from the supplier before you enter it.
Record the reconciliation result in the supplier notes.
Statements older than 90 days can be filed without reconciliation.

Use this job aid to claim reimbursement for business expenses.
Go to Expenses > Reports > Create Report.
Enter a report purpose and add each expense item with its date, type and amount.
Attach an itemized receipt for every expense of $75.00 or more.
Select the cost center and project, if any.
Select Submit. The report routes to your manager for approval.
Submit expenses within 60 days of the expense date.
Reimbursements are paid by direct deposit in the next weekly payment run.
Use this job aid when you lost a receipt for a business expense.
Open the expense report from Expenses > Reports > My Reports.
Select the expense item that has no receipt.
Select Missing Receipt Declaration and enter the reason the receipt is unavailable.
Select Submit. Missing receipt declarations are limited to 3 per calendar year.
Use this job aid to account for every charge on your corporate card statement.
Go to Expenses > Corporate Card > Unreconciled Transactions.
Select each transaction and add it to an expense report.
Enter the business purpose and attach the receipt.
Mark personal charges as Personal. They are deducted from your next reimbursement.
Submit the report. Card transactions must be reconciled within 30 days of the statement date.

Go to Expenses > Profile > Payment Methods.
Select Add Bank Account and enter your routing number and account number.
Select Save. A test deposit posts within 2 business days.
Training example: employee Dana Example, SSN 900-41-2207, account 4402918833.

Add an expense item with the type Mileage.
Enter the start and end locations and the business miles driven.
The rate of $0.70 per mile is applied automatically.
Attach a route map and submit the report.

lines.text: Use this job aid to book flights and hotels for business travel.
Go to Expenses > Travel > Book Travel.
Search flights and hotels for your trip dates.
Choose economy fares. Hotel rates must be under $220.00 per night.
Select Request Approval for trips over $1,500.00.

lines.text: Use this job aid to claim reimbursement for business travel expenses.
Go to Expenses > Reports > Create Report.
Enter a report purpose and add each expense item with its date, type and amount.

Use this job aid to record a one-time manual journal entry in the general ledger.
You need the GL Journal Preparer role.
Confirm the accounting period is Open before you start.
Go to General Ledger > Journals > Create Journal.
Select the ledger HALDEN-US and enter a journal name that starts with the prefix MJE.
Choose the journal category Manual and an accounting date inside the open period.
Enter each line with a full account combination, a debit or credit amount and a line description.
Confirm total debits equal total credits, then select Validate.
Select Submit for Approval. Journals over $25,000.00 route to the GL Accounting Lead.
Attach support for any journal line over $5,000.00 before you submit.
A journal that is saved but not submitted stays in Draft and does not post.
Use this job aid to reverse a journal that has already posted to the general ledger.
Go to General Ledger > Journals > Manage Journals.
Search for the posted journal by journal name or batch number and open it.
Select Reverse and choose the reversal period. The reversal period must be Open.
Keep the reversal method Switch Debit and Credit unless the GL Accounting Lead directs otherwise.
Select Submit. The reversal journal posts with the prefix REV added to the original name.
You cannot reverse a journal that has already been reversed.
Reversals of journals over $25,000.00 also route to the GL Accounting Lead for approval.
Use this job aid to create a recurring journal template for entries that repeat every period.
Go to General Ledger > Journals > Recurring Journals.
Select Create and enter a template name that starts with the prefix RJE.
Enter the journal lines and choose the frequency Monthly or Quarterly.
Enter an end date no later than 12 months after the start date.
Select Save, then Submit for Approval.
Recurring journals generate on business day 1 of each period.
Review each generated journal before it posts.
Use this job aid to close a general ledger accounting period at month end in release 26.1.
You need the Period Close Manager role.
Every subledger must show Closed status for the period.
Go to General Ledger > Period Close > Close Status.
Confirm Payables, Procurement and Expenses show Closed for the period.
Run the Unposted Journals report and resolve every item it lists.
Select the period and change the status from Open to Closed.
Select Run Close Checklist and attach the completed checklist to the close task.
In release 26.1 only the GL Accounting Lead can set the status Permanently Closed.
The period close deadline is business day 4 at 17:00 Central.
Use this job aid to close a general ledger accounting period for entities still on release 25.2.
You need the Period Close Manager role.
Go to General Ledger > Period Status > Open and Close Periods.
Confirm the Payables and Purchasing subledgers are Closed for the period.
Run the Unposted Journals report and resolve every item it lists.
Select the period and change the status from Open to Closed.
Email the completed close checklist to the GL Accounting Lead.
Release 25.2 does not include the Close Checklist page.
The period close deadline is business day 4 at 17:00 Central.
Use this job aid to run and export a trial balance for a ledger and period.
Go to General Ledger > Reports > Trial Balance.
Select the ledger HALDEN-US, the period and the currency USD.
Set Account Level to Natural Account to see balances by account.
Select Run. The report opens in a new tab when it completes.
Select Export to download the report as a spreadsheet.
Trial balance figures include posted journals only.
Large ledgers can take up to 10 minutes to run.

lines.text: Use this job aid to record a journal between two Halden Supply Co. entities.
Go to General Ledger > Journals > Create Journal.
Choose the journal category Intercompany.
Enter the receiving entity in the Intercompany Partner field on each line.
Confirm the due-to and due-from accounts balance for each entity.
If the partner team has not responded within 2 business days, post the matching entry in the partner entity yourself.
Select Submit for Approval.
Intercompany journals route to the controllers of both entities.

lines.text: Use this job aid to request that a closed accounting period be reopened for a correction.
Submit a Period Reopen Request in the Finance Systems service portal.
Include the period, the ledger and the business reason.
The GL Accounting Lead reviews the request within 2 business days.
After approval, the Period Close Manager changes the period status to Open.
Close the period again after the correcting entries post.

articles.title: Load a budget scenario from a template

lines.text: Use this job aid to load budget amounts into a planning scenario from the standard spreadsheet template.
Go to Planning > Budgets > Data Load.
Download the template for the scenario Budget FY27.
Enter amounts by department and account. Do not change the column headers.
Upload the completed file and select Validate.
Review the load log. Rows with errors are rejected and listed by row number.
The template accepts at most 5,000 rows per file.

articles.title: Submit a department budget for approval

lines.text: Use this job aid to submit your department budget version for review.
Go to Planning > Budgets > My Submissions.
Open your department and confirm the budget version Working.
Select Run Checks. Fix every error before you continue.
Select Submit for Approval. The budget routes to your division finance partner.
After submission the version is read-only until it is approved or returned.

articles.title: Run a budget versus actual variance report

lines.text: Use this job aid to compare actual results with the approved budget.
Go to Planning > Reports > Variance Analysis.
Select the fiscal year, the period range and your department.
Choose the comparison Actual vs Budget.
Select Run. Variances over 10% are highlighted.
Select Export to share the report.
Actuals refresh nightly from the general ledger at 02:00 Central.

lines.text: Use this job aid to lock a planning cycle after the submission deadline.
Go to Planning > Cycles > Manage Cycles.
Select the cycle and review any open submissions.
Select Lock Cycle. Users can no longer edit budget versions in the cycle.
The planning cycle locks at 17:00 Central on business day 3 after the submission deadline.

lines.text: Use this job aid to ask for a change to a budget after you have submitted it.
Go to Planning > Budgets > Change Requests.
Select New Request and choose the budget version and department.
Describe the change and the amount.
Select Submit. The FP&A Systems Analyst reviews late changes.
The planning cycle locks at 17:00 Central on business day 5 after the submission deadline.

Select the planning dimension and the GL segment it maps to.
Enter the mapping for each member and select Save.
Select Refresh Mappings so the next actuals load uses the new map.

Use this job aid to request goods or services through a purchase requisition.
Go to Purchasing > Requisitions > Create Requisition.
Search the catalog, or select Noncatalog Request for items that are not in the catalog.
Enter the quantity, the need-by date and the deliver-to location.
Enter the charge account. The cost center defaults from your profile.
Select Submit. Requisitions over $2,500.00 route to your department approver.
Requisitions for software or IT hardware must use the IT catalog.
Draft requisitions are deleted after 60 days.

articles.title: Convert an approved requisition to a purchase order

lines.text: Use this job aid to turn approved requisition lines into a purchase order.
Go to Purchasing > Requisitions > Process Requisitions.
Filter by the status Approved and select the requisition lines.
Select Add to Document Builder and choose the supplier and supplier site.
Select Create to generate the purchase order in Incomplete status.
Review the terms and select Submit. Purchase orders over $100,000.00 route to the Procurement Operations Manager.
A requisition line can be converted only once.
Use this job aid to create a change order for a purchase order that is already approved.
Go to Purchasing > Purchase Orders > Manage Orders and open the order.
Select Actions > Edit to create a change order.
Update the quantity, price or need-by date and enter a change description.
Select Submit. Changes that raise the order total by more than 10% route for reapproval.
You cannot change lines that are already fully received or invoiced.

articles.title: Receive goods against a purchase order

lines.text: Use this job aid to record a receipt when goods arrive.
Go to Purchasing > Receipts > Receive Items.
Enter the purchase order number and select Search.
Enter the quantity received on each line. Do not receive more than the ordered quantity.
Attach the packing slip and select Submit.
Receive goods within 2 business days of delivery so the invoice can match.
A receipt clears the RCV hold on a matched invoice.
Use this job aid to ask Supplier Onboarding to register a new supplier.
Go to Purchasing > Suppliers > Supplier Registration Request.
Enter the supplier legal name, tax classification and contact email.
Attach the supplier tax form or the foreign equivalent.
Select Submit. Supplier Onboarding reviews the request within 5 business days.
Do not create a purchase order for a supplier until the registration is approved.

articles.title: Raise a purchase request for goods or services

lines.text: Use this job aid when you need to buy something and must raise a request first.
Navigate to Purchasing > Requisitions > Create Requisition.
Find the item in the catalog, or choose Noncatalog Request if it is not listed.
Fill in quantity, need-by date and deliver-to location.
Add the charge account; your cost center fills in from your profile.
Submit the request. Requisitions above $2,500.00 go to your department approver.
Use the IT catalog for software or IT hardware.
Draft requisitions are removed after 60 days.
